name: workdone-events
description: Native event subscriptions for the Herdr agents behind WorkDone: ChatGPT is told when an agent finishes a turn, asks a question or sends a message, and gets the final result of turns requested with reply: true.

interface.shortDescription: Get told in chat when a Herdr agent finishes or asks something.
interface.longDescription: Subscribes a ChatGPT chat to the agent.finished, agent.asks and agent.message events of the Herdr agents on your Mac, OVH and Synology, so the chat is woken when an agent finishes a turn or needs an answer. A finished turn that a WorkDone call asked for with reply: true carries its structured result (RESULT: summary, commit, model and effort). It carries events only. To prompt or steer agents, use the WorkDone plugin.
defaultPrompt: Subscribe to agent.finished and tell me here when the agent in relay finishes.
Notify me in this chat when any agent asks me a question.
